discription: A pulse wave synth with an ADSR envelope and subtle pulse width modulation.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pulseWidth=0.5, pwmRate=2, pwmDepth=0.05; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); var pwMod = LFPulse.ar(pwmRate, 0, pwmDepth) + pulseWidth; pwMod = pwMod.clip(0.01, 0.99); sig = LFPulse.ar(freq, pwMod) * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
